instagram_caption:
Jesus, will there be enough money this month?

He did the maths at the kitchen table three times and got the same answer three times. Saturday is still coming. The rent is still the rent.

He did not get a number back. He got a presence. "I never promised you a cushion. I promised you Me."

Hebrews 13:5-6 does not say the account will be full. It says He will never leave you, so you can say, the Lord is my helper, I will not be afraid.

If you are counting the days to payday tonight, you are not counting them alone.
